import subprocess,re,json,hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'c++/learning')
import verify_g
base='60c5562f964717ba224d5e7f6f7bbcfe519a37ed'
allowed={'c++/README.md','c++/learning/README.md','c++/learning/check_docs.py'}
allowed.update(str(p) for p in Path('c++').glob('g0[0-7]-*.md'))
names=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-tree','-r','--name-only',base]).decode().splitlines()
protected,changed=[],[]
for name in names:
    before=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+name])
    current=Path(name).read_bytes()
    entry={'path':name,'base_sha256':hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(),
           'current_sha256':hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest()}
    (protected if before==current else changed).append(entry)
if any(e['path'] not in allowed for e in changed):
    raise SystemExit('unexpected changed tracked file')
preserved={}
for p in sorted(Path('c++').glob('g0[0-4]-*.md')):
    old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+str(p)],text=True)
    new=p.read_text()
    blocks=lambda s:re.findall(r'\x60\x60\x60[^\n]*\n[\s\S]*?\n\x60\x60\x60',s)
    anchors=lambda t:set(re.findall(r'<a id="([^"]+)"',t))
    result={'code_blocks':len(blocks(old)),'all_code_bytes_equal':blocks(old)==blocks(new),
            'old_explicit_anchors_preserved':anchors(old)<=anchors(new),
            'lab_metadata_and_source_equal':verify_g.extract([(p.name,old)])==verify_g.extract([(p.name,new)])}
    assert all(result[k] for k in result if k!='code_blocks'),p
    preserved[str(p)]=result
topics={}
for i in (5,6,7):
    p=next(Path('c++').glob(f'g0{i}-*.md'))
    old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+str(p)],text=True)
    expected=set(re.findall(r'^# (\d+)\. ',old,re.M))
    if i==5:expected.remove('65')
    current=set(re.findall(f'<a id="g{i}-topic-(\\d+)"',p.read_text()))
    assert expected==current,p
    topics[str(p)]={'original_topics':len(expected),'current_topics':len(current)}
print(json.dumps({'base':base,'base_file_count':len(names),'changed':changed,
 'protected':protected,'g0_g4_preservation':preserved,'g5_g7_topic_mapping':topics},ensure_ascii=False))
